items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Somehow my wife and I ran into Nancy Wilson somewhere.

ctx.x: That is my daughter. She was about two or two-and-a-half years of age at the time. Somehow my wife and I ran into Nancy Wilson somewhere. My wife and Nancy Wilson had been friends back in Ohio, Columbus, Ohio. Nancy first saw my little daughter, and she said, “Oh, look at her. She ain’t got no nose.” So immediately the title Little Miss No Nose sprang into my mind, and the song.
